text: Reciprocal rank fusion combines rankings from multiple retrieval channels using reciprocal rank contributions.
The Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B model emits normalized 1024-dimensional vectors in the default AITrans configuration.
The indexer parses source documents and divides their text into stable, traceable chunks.
Retrieved chunks retain source identifiers so the citation service can create program-owned references.
A new index generation becomes visible to queries only after its chunks and manifest have passed validation and publication.
BM25 provides sparse lexical matching and is useful for terms, abbreviations, and exact identifiers.
Qdrant stores dense vectors and supports scoped similarity search over indexed chunks.
